from: chapitre 3 de la vidéo longue (la course des procédés ; coupé : la mise en garde sur les noms de procédés, le retard du 7 nm d'Intel et la chute de l'action ; phrases resserrées pour tenir en moins d'une minute)
paragraphs: In 2013, Intel promised {ten-nanometer|10 nm} chips by 2015.
That slipped to 2016, then to late 2017. Real volume came in 2019.
Meanwhile, TSMC reached {seven nanometers|7 nm} in 2018, and {five|5 nm} in 2020. The best factories weren't Intel's anymore.
In 2020, Apple announced it would drop Intel for its own chips, built by TSMC.
And AMD, with no factories since 2009, rode TSMC too. From less than {one percent|1%} of server processors in 2017, to {forty-six percent|46%} of x86 server processor revenue in early 2026.
Intel's great advantage, its own factories, had become its biggest weakness. Full story on the channel.
